Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def largest_rectangle(heights):
    best, stack = 0, []
    for i, height in enumerate(list(heights) + [0]):
        while stack and heights[stack[-1]] > height:
            h = heights[stack.pop()]
            left = stack[-1] + 1 if stack else 0
            best = max(best, h * (i - left))
        stack.append(i)
    return best

assert largest_rectangle([2,1,5,6,2,3]) == 10
```
explanation: The monotonic stack finds the maximal span for each bar. O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space; the trailing zero flushes remaining bars.
